job_description: VoiceScript is building AI-powered transcription and workflow tools for legal, court reporting, and professional services teams. Our product combines audio/video upload, real-time transcription, speaker diarization, transcript editing, quality review, and AI-assisted formatting into a professional-grade web application. We are looking for a full-time UI / UX Designer in Jakarta who can help us turn complex workflows into clear, elegant, high-quality product experiences. You should be comfortable owning the design process from user flows and wireframes through to high-fidelity Figma designs ready for engineering handoff. What you’ll do You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations to design features for VoiceScript’s web applications, including transcript editing, audio playback, review workflows, dashboards, job management, and admin tools. Who you are You are detail-oriented, practical, and product-minded. You care about making software feel simple, fast, and reliable. You can think through edge cases, empty states, loading states, error states, and the small details that make a product feel polished. You do not need to be a researcher-only UX designer. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys hands-on product design and high-fidelity UI work. Location and working style This is a full-time role based in Jakarta. We prefer someone who can work hybrid or on-site with the team, especially during onboarding and product planning sessions. How to apply After applying we will message a screening form. Please be prepared to send: Your CV or LinkedIn profile. A portfolio of product design work, ideally including web app or SaaS examples. A short note explaining one product design project you are proud of and what your role was. We are especially interested in seeing examples of Figma work that show clear user flows, polished interface design, and thoughtful handling of real product complexity.
qualification: Strong experience designing web applications, SaaS products, dashboards, or complex internal tools. Excellent Figma skills, including components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, and design handoff. A strong eye for layout, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and interaction design. Ability to design both the overall user journey and the detailed UI states needed for implementation. Experience working with product managers and software engineers. Comfort designing for complex workflows, not just simple landing pages or marketing sites. A portfolio showing high-quality UI / UX work for real products. Good written and spoken English. Nice to have These are not required, but would be helpful: Experience designing productivity tools, editing interfaces, legal tech, media tools, or workflow software. Experience with React-based products or working closely with frontend engineers. Understanding of responsive web design and accessibility basics. Experience creating or maintaining a design system. Interest in AI products, transcription, audio/video workflows, or professional services software.

job_description: At Aleph, we design human experiences by asking the right questions. Here, you’d find a curious breed of creative engineers spread across the globe, specializing in craft, strategy, and technology. With a keen ear to the ground, we turn big dreams into user-first digital solutions by design. Through rigorous prototyping, close collaboration, and responsive engineering, we commit to creating a future that leaves our craft, community, and clients better than before. ​​We’re looking for a skilled and curious Product & UX Researcher to join our team and support the revamp of a major banking platform. You’ll be embedded in a cross-functional project squad alongside UI/UX Designers and the client’s Product and Business teams. Your role is to uncover user needs, pain points, and opportunities — and to champion those insights to shape the next generation of banking experiences. As the team’s Researcher, you will own the end-to-end research process and help guide both product and design decisions. You’ll also contribute to defining post-launch success metrics to ensure the solutions we create have measurable impact. Here are your key responsibilities: Collaborate with the internal project squad and the client’s stakeholders to define research goals and select the most effective approaches (interviews, FGDs, participatory design, usability testing, surveys, A/B testing, data analysis, etc). Translate business questions into focused research plans and activities that generate actionable insights. Lead end-to-end research: plan, recruit, conduct, analyze, and report — including managing research operations for the project. Present findings in clear, structured, and compelling formats (e.g., report documents, insight decks, or synthesis frameworks). Act as a user advocate in design discussions, participating in ideation and helping shape the UX. Co-define product success metrics and performance indicators with the team; help build a framework for ongoing tracking and optimization. Ensure all research activities adhere to ethical and legal standards, especially around handling sensitive customer and financial data.
qualification: This role is ideal for you who possess: At least 3 years of full-time experience in UX or product research, ideally in client-facing roles or in complex digital environments such as banking, fintech, or other regulated domains. Proven ability to run both qualitative and quantitative research independently and collaboratively – from planning, recruiting, conducting, analyzing, reporting, and managing research operations for the project. Strong communication and storytelling skills, both in written and verbal formats — able to distill findings and influence both internal and external stakeholders. Ability to operate several research tools (e.g., Maze, UsabilityHub), analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude), and data analysis tools (e.g., SPSS, R). Comfortable interpreting data from BI tools and product analytics dashboards; familiar with product and UX performance metrics. Experienced in facilitating ideation or co-creation workshops using several product frameworks (e.g. JTBD, Value Proposition Canvas, Opportunity Mapping) Self-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about high-quality research and meaningful outcomes. Adaptable and resilient — able to work within tight timelines, shifting requirements, and complex stakeholder environments.

job_description: About MixWork & Our Client MixWork is the premier HR outsourcing partner for strategic workforce solutions, empowering brands and global organizations with skilled, dedicated, and professional top-tier regional teams from South East Asia to accelerate their business growth. On behalf of our client, a premier, household-name retail enterprise headquartered in Singapore with a well-established international footprint and a heritage of quality and operational excellence, we are seeking a dedicated professional to join their team as they actively modernize their omni-channel capabilities and leverage a sophisticated regional technology footprint to support their digital and brick-and-mortar operations. Role Summary Own our client's internal IT security governance and compliance posture, and serve as an independent check-and-balance on our client's outsourced MSSP (Managed Security Service Provider). While the MSSP handles SOC operations, CrowdStrike EDR management, firewall management, and NG-SIEM monitoring, this role must have sufficient technical understanding of those platforms to critically review MSSP outputs, challenge findings, identify gaps in MSSP coverage, and provide the Head of IT with an independent assessment of our client's security posture. This person cannot simply accept MSSP reports at face value, they must have the knowledge to know what good looks like, what should have been detected but was not, and whether remediation actions are appropriate. Key Responsibilities Serve as our client's independent internal security check-and-balance against the MSSP: review monthly MSSP reports (CrowdStrike EDR threat summary, Fortinet/WatchGuard firewall analysis, NG-SIEM incident report) with sufficient technical depth to identify gaps, missed detections, or inadequate responses, and escalate concerns to the Head of IT. Manage the MSSP SLA: own the relationship, track KPIs, drive remediation timelines for identified vulnerabilities, and hold the MSSP accountable for SLA compliance. Manage our client's Microsoft 365 security posture independently: Microsoft Defender for M365, Conditional Access policies, DLP policies, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, and Microsoft Intune endpoint compliance. Own identity and access governance across all our client’s systems: Entra ID RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), quarterly access reviews across all SaaS platforms and Azure. Own and maintain our client's IT Security Policy, Acceptable Use Policy, Data Classification Policy, and Incident Response Plan. Support the Head of IT (DPO) with PDPA compliance: Data Processing Agreement register, DPIAs for new system onboarding, ROPA maintenance, and data breach response coordination. Conduct annual security awareness training for all our client’s staff (Singapore and Jakarta); run biannual phishing simulation campaigns. Assess new SaaS platforms from a security perspective: data access review, access control configuration, and DPA agreement completion. Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 5 years of IT security experience, combining hands-on Microsoft 365 security stack knowledge with security governance capability. SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst Associate) or equivalent certification required. Working knowledge of CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR platform): sufficient to understand prevention policies, detection logic, and threat hunt outputs, able to interrogate MSSP CrowdStrike reports and identify whether detections and responses are appropriate. Full CCFR certification is not required; credible technical familiarity is. Working knowledge of NG-SIEM platforms (WatchGuard or equivalent) and firewall security (Fortinet/WatchGuard): sufficient to review MSSP threat analysis and challenge findings where appropriate. Demonstrable experience managing Conditional Access policies, PIM, and RBAC in a production Azure/M365 environment. Practical PDPA or equivalent data protection compliance experience. English proficiency at B2 minimum (IELTS 6.0); mandatory assessment at interview. Demonstrated proactive independence: surfaces security gaps without being prompted; challenges MSSP outputs with evidence; drives remediation without being managed. Technical Proficiency Microsoft 365 security: Defender for M365, Conditional Access, PIM, DLP, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Intune. Azure Entra ID: RBAC, security groups, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection. CrowdStrike Falcon: working knowledge of the platform, prevention policies, detection triage, and threat hunt report interpretation. Sufficient to independently review MSSP outputs. NG-SIEM (WatchGuard or equivalent): ability to read and critically interpret SIEM alert reports, correlation rules, and incident summaries provided by the MSSP. Firewall security (Fortinet/WatchGuard): understanding of firewall threat analysis reports and rule logic, sufficient for informed review of MSSP firewall management. Security governance: policy authoring, risk register management, DPA and ROPA documentation. PDPA compliance framework: DPIA process, breach notification procedures, data retention policy. Nice to Have CISSP, CISM, or AZ-500 certification. CrowdStrike CCFR or CCFA certification (advantageous for deeper MSSP oversight). PDP compliance experience. NIST CSF or ISO 27001 familiarity. Statutory Provisions & Compliance Full Legal Compliance: Official employment contract managed under MixWork Indonesia, ensuring complete adherence to local labor laws and employment standards. Healthcare & Social Security: Full registration and contributions for both BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan to ensure comprehensive coverage. Religious Holiday Allowance: Guaranteed annual mandatory Religious Holiday Allowance (THR) paid in accordance with statutory government regulations. What We Offer Flexible Medical Benefit: Comprehensive healthcare coverage fully inclusive of dental, optical, outpatient care, and wellness treatments to support your overall well-being. Daily Allowances: Competitive transportation and meal allowances to support your operational needs. Workstation Provisioning: High-performance corporate laptop and necessary technical equipment provided. Regional Ecosystem: Access to ongoing global corporate alignment, dedicated HR support, and a stable, creative career trajectory with a premier international brand. Important Notes Language Requirement: As this is an international role, please note that all screenings and interviews will be conducted exclusively in English. Equal Opportunity Employer: MixWork is committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and fair workplace culture. We value talent and capability above all else, completely free from discrimination or bias.

job_description: PT Matahari Raya Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang manufaktur dan distribusi produk konsumen, yang telah lama dikenal sebagai salah satu pemain utama di pasar Indonesia. Kami sedang mencari individu yang kompeten dan berkomitmen untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Curug, Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten. Kesempatan ini sangat cocok bagi Anda yang ingin berkembang dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan profesional, serta memiliki minat dalam menjaga standar kualitas produk yang tinggi. Sebagai Quality Inspector dan Quality Control serta Quality Assurance, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas pemeriksaan kualitas produk baik dari sisi masuk, proses, maupun keluar. Anda akan melakukan inspeksi terhadap bahan baku, komponen, dan produk jadi sesuai dengan standar yang ditetapkan. Selain itu, Anda juga akan memastikan bahwa seluruh proses produksi berjalan sesuai dengan protokol kualitas yang berlaku, serta memberikan laporan secara berkala mengenai hasil pemeriksaan dan rekomendasi perbaikan jika diperlukan. 1. Kualifikasi Pendidikan : Minimal Pendidikan: D3 atau S1. Jurusan yang Diutamakan: Teknik Industri, Manajemen, Farmasi, Teknik Kimia, atau Logistik. IPK Minimal: Umumnya ≥ 3.00 dari skala 4.00 2. Pengalaman Kerja Minimal 1–3 tahun pengalaman di bidang PPIC, logistik, atau Supply Chain. Memiliki pengalaman langsung di pabrik manufaktur kosmetik, skincare, atau FMCG. 3. Keahlian & Keterampilan Teknis (Hard Skills)Manajemen Persediaan: Kemampuan mengontrol Raw Material (bahan baku), Packaging Material (bahan kemas), Work in Process (barang setengah jadi), dan Finished Goods (barang jadi). Sistem Perangkat Lunak: Terbiasa mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (seperti VLOOKUP, Pivot, macro) dan sistem ERP (seperti SAP, Oracle, atau sejenisnya). Standar Industri: Paham mengenai regulasi kosmetik, standar GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), dan CPKB. Perencanaan: Kemampuan membaca forecasting penjualan untuk dibuat menjadi jadwal produksi (Master Production Schedule). 4. Kemampuan Personal & Manajerial (Soft Skills)Analisis & Problem Solving: Mampu menganalisis kapasitas gudang, menghitung siklus produksi, dan mengatasi masalah jika terjadi keterlambatan bahan. Komunikasi: Kemampuan koordinasi yang kuat dengan berbagai divisi seperti R&D, Procurement, Produksi, Quality Control (QC), hingga Marketing. Teliti & Detail: Tingkat ketelitian yang tinggi untuk meminimalisir selisih stok (stock opname) dan kesalahan pengadaan.

job_description: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position We are looking for a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) professional who will play a key role in strengthening the organization’s risk management and compliance practices. In this role, you will lead risk assessments across business and technology functions, ensure compliance with security and regulatory frameworks such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and coordinate internal and external audits. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to embed effective controls into business processes while providing clear reporting and guidance to help the organization manage risk and maintain strong governance standards. Job Description: Lead enterprise and technology risk assessments across business and operational functions. Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and compliance documentation. Manage compliance readiness for frameworks such as SO 27001, SOC 2, and PDP laws. Coordinate internal and external audits, control reviews, and remediation tracking. Maintain risk registers, issue logs, exception records, and control matrices. Conduct vendor and third-party risk assessments for critical partners and service providers. Support business continuity and resilience governance activities. Provide regular reporting to management on risk exposure, control effectiveness, compliance status, and remediation progress. Work closely with Security, Engineering, Product, Legal, Operations, and Finance to embed controls into business processes. Deliver awareness sessions and practical guidance to improve risk ownership across the organization.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. 4+ years of experience in GRC, IT audit, compliance, risk management, or information security governance. Experience in a technology company, especially in e-commerce, quickcommerce, fintech, or logistics is strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of risk management, internal controls, audits, and security/compliance frameworks. Familiarity with I SO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and privacy-related compliance practices. Strong communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in fast-paced and high-growth environments is a strong advantage.

job_description: Reporting to the Business Performance Manager, you will be responsible for engineering and operationalizing ATI Business Group’s RPA and Agentic Automation capabilities to accelerate intelligent execution, reduce manual operational effort, and ensure automation systems are reliable, scalable, and production-ready. job_title: Business Development Utilities Officer at PT Kawasan Industri Terpadu Batang member of PT Danareksa Persero
location: Pelabuhan, Ketanggan, Kec. Gringsing, Kabupaten Batang, Jawa Tengah 51281
job_description: Analisis Kebutuhan dan Peluang Layanan Utilitas Mengumpulkan data kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk berbagai jenis layanan utilitas kawasan. Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan layanan utilitas baru atau penguatan layanan yang sudah ada. Menganalisis kesesuaian kebutuhan tenant dengan potensi pengembangan bisnis utilitas kawasan. Pengembangan Skema Bisnis Utilitas Menyusun konsep awal skema bisnis layanan utilitas berdasarkan kebutuhan tenant dan arah pengembangan kawasan. Mengkaji alternatif model layanan, skema kerja sama, dan potensi monetisasi masing-masing layanan utilitas. Menyiapkan bahan analisis untuk penyempurnaan skema bisnis utilitas kawasan. Penyusunan Model Bisnis dan Kajian Finansial Awal Mengumpulkan data dasar biaya, asumsi CAPEX, OPEX, dan proyeksi pendapatan layanan utilitas. Menyusun perhitungan awal model bisnis, cost recovery, dan potensi revenue sharing. Menganalisis kelayakan awal model bisnis utilitas untuk bahan evaluasi atasan. Dukungan Feasibility Study Utilitas Menyiapkan data pasar, kebutuhan tenant, serta asumsi komersial untuk studi kelayakan. Melakukan analisis awal terhadap aspek bisnis, pasar, dan potensi komersial pengembangan utilitas. Menyusun bahan rekomendasi untuk penilaian kelayakan investasi utilitas. Proyeksi Kebutuhan Utilitas Tenant Mengumpulkan data pemakaian dan kebutuhan utilitas tenant untuk jangka pendek, menengah, dan panjang. Mengolah data proyeksi kebutuhan utilitas sebagai dasar perencanaan komersial. Menyelaraskan hasil proyeksi dengan potensi pertumbuhan tenant dan kawasan. Monetisasi dan Pengembangan Produk Layanan Mengidentifikasi peluang monetisasi dari layanan utilitas yang tersedia. Menyusun usulan pengembangan produk atau skema layanan untuk meningkatkan penetrasi ke tenant. Memantau perkembangan pipeline peluang bisnis utilitas dan tindak lanjutnya. Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi Bisnis Utilitas Menyusun laporan hasil analisis peluang bisnis dan kebutuhan tenant. Mendokumentasikan draf model bisnis, proyeksi, dan kajian awal yang telah disusun. Menyampaikan laporan untuk kebutuhan evaluasi dan pengambilan keputusan atasan. Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko.
qualification: (S1) di bidang Teknik Industri, Teknik Sipil, Teknik Lingkungan, Manajemen, Ekonomi, atau bidang lain yang relevan. Pengembangan Bisnis Utilitas : Pemahaman dalam penyusunan dan pengembangan skema bisnis layanan utilitas kawasan. Analisis Kelayakan Bisnis : Kemampuan dalam melakukan feasibility study dan analisis aspek teknis, finansial, dan komersial. Financial Modeling : Pemahaman dalam penyusunan model keuangan, termasuk CAPEX, OPEX, cost recovery, dan proyeksi pendapatan. Perencanaan dan Forecasting : Pengetahuan dalam melakukan proyeksi kebutuhan utilitas dan potensi pasar tenant. Analisis Pasar dan Produk : Pemahaman dalam mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, pengembangan produk layanan, dan peningkatan penetrasi pasar. job_description: This role will enable Customer Growth & Marketing (CGM) teams to scale acquisition, retention, and campaign execution efficiently by reducing manual work, improving data reliability, and standardizing processes through better systems, automation, and operating frameworks. Key Responsibilities 1. Marketing Process & Workflow Optimization Map and redesign end-to-end CGM workflows, from campaign planning and budget allocation to execution, tracking, and post-mortem. Identify and address bottlenecks across general CGM business processes, including but not limited to: Budget request and approval flows Campaign and experimentation lifecycle Reporting and data tracking Drive the transition from fragmented and manual workflows into standardized, scalable operating models. 2. Standardization, SOP & Governance Develop and implement standardized SOPs, templates, and guardrails across Customer Growth & Marketing to ensure consistent execution and reduce operational risk. Build structured operational playbooks (e.g., promo playbook) and automation SOPs to improve repeatability and reduce dependency on manual coordination. Establish clear documentation frameworks for campaign briefs, execution steps, and post-mortem processes to ensure learnings are captured and reused. 3. Data, Dashboard & Automation Enablement Drive initiatives to automate marketing reporting and performance tracking, reducing reliance on manual data pulls and spreadsheets. Work with Data and Analytics teams to define reporting requirements and improve data availability, accuracy, and usability for CGM teams. Identify and prioritize opportunities where automation or tooling can significantly improve operational efficiency and decision-making speed. 4. Cross-Functional Execution & Platform Collaboration Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Finance, and other stakeholders to support implementation of process or platform improvements at an operational level. Support testing, rollout, and iteration of new tools, dashboards, and workflows to ensure they meet day-to-day CGM operational needs.
qualification: Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or other relevant fields. Candidates from other disciplines are welcome, provided they demonstrate strong experience in process improvement, data handling, and cross-functional project work. Experience Minimum of 4 years of experience in Marketing Operations, Growth Operations, Business Operations, or similar roles. Proven track record supporting high-volume campaign environments and cross-functional marketing initiatives. Process & Operational Excellence Strong experience mapping, redesigning, and standardizing end-to-end workflows into scalable SOPs. Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, reduce manual work, and improve operational turnaround time. Data & Reporting Solid understanding of marketing performance metrics and reporting frameworks. Proficiency in spreadsheet and presentation tools (e.g., Excel / Google Sheets, PowerPoint / Slides). Familiarity with BI and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent) and ticketing tools (e.g JIRA) Hands-on experience working with dashboards to define, build, or improve reporting structures. Automation & Platform Collaboration Experience driving or implementing process automation and system improvements. Proven ability to work with Product, Data, or Engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions. Stakeholder & Change Management Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across Marketing, Finance, and Data teams. Experience driving adoption of new tools, processes, or ways of working through training and enablement. Personal Attributes Structured, systems-thinking mindset with strong attention to detail. Proactive, ownership-driven, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.

job_description: About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position As a Quality Control Senior Supervisor, you will lead the end-to-end QC function for Fresh categories (fruits, vegetables, eggs, dairy, frozen products, etc.) within the warehouse . This role is responsible for ensuring product quality standards are maintained from inbound to outbound, minimizing waste, and ensuring compliance with product specifications and temperature handling standards. Responsibilities Oversee inbound QC processes (verify, assess, investigate) to determine product acceptance or rejection based on quality standards. Conduct stock screening in storage areas to identify near-expiry products and define appropriate action plans. Ensure proper temperature handling across all stages (inbound, storage, outbound). Collaborate with Category Management regarding product specification discrepancies and negotiate when necessary. Manage over-commitment issues with vendors (size, weight, or specification mismatches). Analyze waste across all operational stages and implement improvement initiatives to reduce shrinkage. Lead and supervise QC team members (±20 direct reports; ±45 total QC staff in warehouse). Collect, validate, and process quality data for reporting and decision-making purposes.
qualification: Bachelor’s Degree (S1/D4) from any major; preferably Food Science, Agribusiness, or Management. Strong knowledge of warehouse and logistics operations, particularly within e-commerce or retail industries. Minimum 2 years of experience as a QA/QC Supervisor handling fresh or frozen products in FMCG, Retail, E-commerce, or F&B industries. Hands-on experience managing fresh and frozen products including fruits, vegetables, eggs, dairy, and frozen food. Proven leadership skills with solid judgment and decision-making capabilities. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset with experience in validating and processing quality data. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic retail environment and meet agreed deadlines.

job_description: PT BSR Indonesia telah berdiri sejak tahun 2008 sebagai penyedia layanan sumber daya manusia, administrasi keamanan, pusat layanan pelanggan, dan layanan lainnya yang profesional dan terpercaya. Kandidat harus memiliki kemampuan dalam manajemen vendor, pengadaan, pengelolaan pemasok, pembelian komoditas, manajemen pengadaan, serta negosiasi pembelian. Kami mengundang para profesional yang bersemangat dan siap berkontribusi dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan profesional.

location: 1157, Rodriguez Ave, Bangkal
job_description: ABOUT US We are looking for individuals who can evangelize the idea that productive work can be done from anywhere! Right now businesses are spending billions on larger than necessary workspaces. The pandemic has forced businesses to consider work-from-home arrangements, but businesses are struggling to see this as a sustainable and productive way to move forward. Squadzip is the Digital Extension of the Office, a platform that serves as a central reporting hub for all types of customer interactions, face-to-face interactions, video calls, voice calls, messaging, and more. We are looking for a few, energetic, driven individuals to help us spread this movement across the world. We're building a reliable, secure, and scalable DevOps infrastructure to support our growing applications. Our team focuses on automation, cloud efficiency, and security best practices while ensuring smooth deployments and system reliability. We run on AWS, Docker, and CI/CD automation, and we're continuously improving our cloud infrastructure, security, and database performance. THE ROLE This is an AWS infrastructure and operations focused DevOps role. The position focuses on AWS cloud infrastructure, system reliability, monitoring, and security operations. While some scripting and automation is required, this is NOT a software development role . If you love optimizing cloud environments, automating workflows, and implementing security best practices, we’d love to have you onboard! Responsibilities: AWS Infrastructure & Security - Follow AWS Well-Architected - learn, measure, and build using architectural best practices. - Design, deploy, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure (Fargate, ECS, ECR, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch and others). - Implement IAM best practices, access control, and security logging. - Monitor system logs, security alerts, and cloud compliance tools to maintain a secure environment. - Research current and existing technologies for potential use. - Help troubleshoot and fix problems in production. - Strong interest in Linux system administration, cloud infrastructure operations, and production system reliability. Containerization & CI/CD - Manage Docker containers and optimize AWS Fargate workloads. - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeCommit. - Conduct security scanning (e.g., Trivy, AWS Inspector) on container images. PostgreSQL & Database Operations - Deploy and maintain automated backups. - Configure connection pooling and security. - Implement PostgreSQL read replicas for scaling. - Monitor database performance and ensure secure database configurations. Security & Monitoring - Maintain AWS Security best practices, including encryption, logging, and monitoring. - Implement network security controls (VPC, security groups, firewall rules). - Automate security checks and proactively identify vulnerabilities in cloud workloads. Nice-to-Have Skills (Big Plus, but Not Required): - Familiarity with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Memcached. - Experience with AWS WAF, GuardDuty, or security auditing tools. - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience with CloudFormation. - Knowledge of Redis & Memcached performance tuning. - Scripting experience in Bash, Python, or Ruby. - New Relic - Gitlab - Fastlane - Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile (Android and iOS) - Familiarity with Automated Testing Why Join Us? - Work with a cloud-first DevOps team focused on security & automation. - Solve AWS scaling and deployment challenges. - Opportunities to grow in DevOps, security, and cloud architecture.
qualification: - Preferably with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or Computer Engineering. - At least 1 year of experience in AWS DevOps, Infrastructure Security, and Automation. - Hands-on experience with Docker and AWS. - Experience with AWS IAM policies, security logging, and monitoring tools. - Strong experience in CI/CD pipeline automation (AWS CodePipeline or similar). - Comfortable with Linux and Linux CLI. - Experience with Linux system administration & cloud networking.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

job_description: Sebagai Book Advisor (Storekeeper & Cashier) , kamu akan berperan dalam menciptakan pengalaman belanja yang hangat dan menyenangkan bagi pelanggan dengan membantu mereka menemukan buku yang tepat serta memberikan rekomendasi yang mendalam dan personal. Posisi ini menuntut pengetahuan yang kuat tentang buku, genre, tren literasi, serta ketertarikan yang tinggi terhadap dunia buku , karena Book Advisor tidak hanya melayani pelanggan, tetapi juga membangun engagement dengan produk secara autentik dan penuh passion. Tugas utama mencakup pengelolaan transaksi penjualan, memastikan ketersediaan stok, serta mendukung berbagai program dan kampanye toko. Peran ini juga membutuhkan keterampilan komunikasi yang baik untuk membangun hubungan dengan pelanggan, menyampaikan informasi buku secara menarik, dan meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan. Selain itu, Anda akan bekerja sama dengan tim dalam mengelola operasional harian toko, menyiapkan kebutuhan acara, serta memastikan proses pembelian berjalan lancar sesuai prosedur, dari tampilan buku hingga transaksi di kasir. Key Responsibilities: Sales and Customer Advisory Melayani pelanggan dengan ramah dan menciptakan pengalaman belanja yang hangat. Memberikan rekomendasi buku yang mendalam berdasarkan preferensi pelanggan untuk membangun loyalitas. Menggunakan keterampilan komunikasi yang menarik untuk menyampaikan informasi buku dan meningkatkan interaksi pelanggan. Product and Inventory Management Menguasai koleksi buku yang tersedia dan memahami tren literasi terkini untuk memberikan insight berharga kepada pelanggan. Memastikan ketersediaan stok buku dan melaporkan kebutuhan restock agar pelanggan selalu mendapatkan produk yang mereka cari. Berjejaring dengan tim dan manajemen untuk menyusun strategi display buku yang menarik dan sesuai dengan promosi. Store Operations Mengelola transaksi penjualan dan memastikan pembayaran berjalan lancar sesuai SOP. Memastikan pembelian pelanggan dilakukan dengan tertib dan efisien, dari display hingga kasir. Menyusun laporan harian terkait kinerja tim dan pengalaman pelanggan untuk evaluasi layanan. Mengidentifikasi serta menyelesaikan kendala operasional toko dengan pendekatan yang solutif dan efisien. Store Programmes and Collaboration with Team to Reach Success Berkomunikasi dengan tim untuk mengumpulkan feedback dan ide perbaikan layanan. Mendukung pelaksanaan program atau kampanye toko untuk meningkatkan engagement pelanggan dan daya tarik toko. Menyesuaikan strategi promosi dan event toko berdasarkan tren dan kebutuhan pelanggan.
qualification: Education & Experience: Pengalaman di bidang ritel, lebih disukai di industri buku atau literasi. Pernah terlibat dalam organisasi atau komunitas yang berkaitan dengan buku, literasi, atau layanan pelanggan menjadi nilai tambah. Pengalaman dalam pelayanan pelanggan, rekomendasi produk, atau penjualan lebih diutamakan. Skills & Knowledge: Pengetahuan luas tentang buku , genre, tren literasi, serta penerbit dan penulis. Kemampuan untuk merekomendasikan buku berdasarkan preferensi pelanggan secara informatif dan menarik. Pemahaman dasar tentang bahasa Inggris untuk memahami berbagai literatur dan buku impor. Ensure deliverables meet functional requirements, technical standards, and quality expectations before release. Communicate implementation progress, technical constraints, and risks clearly to internal teams and clients when necessary. Implement new features based on product and business requirements with full understanding of impact and dependencies. Follow established architecture patterns and coding standards. Write clean, modular, and maintainable code. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Backend Engineers, QA teams, and stakeholders. Participate actively in code reviews and apply feedback constructively. Identify and resolve bugs, performance issues, and stability problems proactively. Ensure compatibility across supported iOS versions and Apple devices. Contribute to improving testing coverage, CI/CD processes, and release quality. Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and technical discussions with accountability. Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience. 2–5 years of hands-on experience developing iOS applications. Strong proficiency in Swift and solid understanding of iOS SDK. Experience implementing MVVM or similar architectural patterns. Understanding of Clean Architecture principles and modularization concepts. Solid knowledge of OOP, protocol-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns. Experience working with concurrency (GCD, async/await). Experience integrating RESTful APIs and handling JSON-based communication. Strong understanding of iOS lifecycle, threading, and memory management (ARC). Familiarity with dependency injection patterns. Experience using Git and collaborative code review workflows. Awareness of deliverable quality standards, including testing, edge-case handling, and production stability. Ability to clearly communicate technical progress, issues, and solutions to team members and clients. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. Professional attitude, accountability, and ownership mindset. Preferred Qualification: Experience with SwiftUI or advanced UIKit usage. Experience writing unit tests like XCTest, etc. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. Experience working with apps published on the Apple App Store. Experience using Xcode Instruments for basic performance profiling. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Exposure to modular or multi-target iOS projects. Experience participating in client discussions or requirement clarification sessions.

job_description: We are seeking a motivated Android Developer with a backend mindset to design, build, and maintain Jetpack Compose-driven applications backed by Node.js services. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features end-to-end — from crafting declarative interfaces to building and consuming the APIs that power them. You'll work closely with designers, product managers, and senior engineers to deliver polished, full-stack mobile experiences. Key Responsibilities Jetpack Compose Development & Feature Delivery • Build and maintain Android applications using Jetpack Compose as the primary UI framework. • Create reusable, composable UI components following MVVM architecture. • Leverage Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for reactive data flows and concurrency. • Implement navigation, state management, animations, and gesture handling using Compose idioms. • Translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate, responsive Compose layouts across device sizes and form factors. Node.js Backend Development • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js with Express or Fastify. • Design database schemas and perform CRUD operations with PostgreSQL or MySQL. • Implement authentication flows, middleware, and input validation on the server side. • Write clean, documented API endpoints that the Android layer consumes directly. • Support deployment and environment management using Docker, PM2, or cloud platforms. Integration & Code Quality • Connect Compose UI to backend services using Retrofit, OkHttp, or Ktor Client. • Handle JSON serialization and deserialization with Kotlin Serialization or Gson. • Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback across both codebases. • Use Git for version control and follow consistent branching strategies. Performance, Debugging & Monitoring • Profile and optimize Compose rendering performance using Android Studio Profiler. • Monitor and triage crashes using Firebase Crashlytics. • Log, monitor, and debug Node.js services using tools like Morgan or Datadog. • Ensure smooth performance across supported Android versions and device types. Continuous Learning & Growth • Stay current with Jetpack library updates, new Android APIs, and Google I/O announcements. • Follow Node.js ecosystem developments including framework updates and security patches. • Share knowledge with the team through demos, documentation, or internal tech talks. • Explore emerging patterns such as Glance for widgets, Material 3, and server-driven UI.
qualification: Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 1–3 years of Android development experience with at least one Jetpack Compose-based app shipped to the Google Play Store. Proficiency in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose; understanding of the declarative UI paradigm. Working knowledge of Node.js and experience building or maintaining REST APIs. Familiarity with PostgreSQL or MySQL. Understanding of MVVM architecture and clean separation of concerns. Experience consuming and designing RESTful APIs with JSON. Comfortable using Android Studio, terminal-based workflows, and Git. Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn across the stack. Preferred Skills • Experience with Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, and StateFlow for reactive programming. • Familiarity with TypeScript on the backend. • Exposure to Next.js for server-side rendering, API routes, or full-stack web companion apps. • Experience with ORMs such as Prisma, Drizzle, or TypeORM for type-safe database access. • Familiarity with tRPC for end-to-end type-safe API layers. • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines using Fastlane, GitHub Actions, or Firebase App Distribution. • Experience with Docker for local development and deployment. • Knowledge of Firebase services (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Messaging). • Familiarity with Room for local persistence and data caching strategies. • Familiarity with WebSockets or real-time data patterns. • Understanding of accessibility best practices and localization in Compose. • Any exposure to GraphQL or serverless functions is a plus. Tools & Technologies • Languages: Kotlin (primary), JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js) • Android Frameworks: Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, Room, WorkManager • Backend: Node.js, Express/Fastify, PostgreSQL, MySQL • Backend (Plus): Next.js, tRPC, Prisma/Drizzle • IDE & Tooling: Android Studio, VS Code, Terminal • Design Handoff: Figma • Version Control: Git (GitHub or GitLab) • CI/CD: Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Firebase App Distribution • Monitoring: Firebase Crashlytics, Datadog • Project Management: Jira

job_description: Objective Serve as a critical bridge between business and product needs and technical execution, and will be involved in every step of the pre-sales solutioning process by actively engaging with clients to understand their business objectives, pain points, and technical requirements, and exploring potential opportunities to provide relevant solutions and offerings to meet their needs. Translate technical expertise and project success into compelling external content. Develop blogs, research reports, and marketing collateral (including portfolio documents) to showcase NBS’s capabilities and market expertise. Required Experience & Technical Skills Software Engineering, Product Development, Public Speaking, and Business. job_description: 🌟 Bring Your Creative Vision to Life at Gentem Indonesia 🌟 Are you passionate about transforming ideas into powerful visual stories? At Gentem Indonesia, we’re building a dynamic brand that connects people and ideas through bold design and authentic storytelling. As a Senior Creative Designer Specialist, you’ll play a key role in shaping our visual identity, crafting impactful content, and bringing fresh creativity to every campaign. ✨ What You’ll Be Doing: Video Editing & Motion Graphics: Edit and produce high-quality video content (ads, promos, social media videos) with a focus on engagement and brand storytelling Create dynamic motion graphics to enhance video content and elevate the viewer experience, aligning with brand guidelines Develop animated assets for digital platforms, including banners, ads, and explainer videos. Color grade some videos if needed to beautify the look of the videos Videography: Conceptualize, shoot, and produce compelling video content for marketing campaigns, internal communications, and social media platforms Oversee the entire video production process, from pre-production to shooting and post-production Ensure that video content is optimized for various platforms and meets brand standards. UI/UX Design: Lead UI/UX design projects, creating user-centered designs that enhance user experiences across web, mobile, and app interfaces Collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to design intuitive, interactive interfaces that reflect brand identity. Create wireframes, prototypes, and interactive design concepts that effectively communicate the user journey. Creative Design Execution: Collaborate with the creative team to deliver high-quality design solutions for both digital and print mediums Create assets for social media, email templates, websites, landing pages, and banners Ensure timely delivery of creative work while maintaining high standards for design. Additional Creative Design Tasks: Design collateral materials such as brochures, presentations, and other marketing assets Support design needs across all teams, from branding to product packaging, creating a cohesive and visually appealing brand presence. Video Editing & Motion Graphics Produce 4–6 campaign-ready videos per month — edited, color-graded, and platform-optimized — with zero back-to-brief revisions after final Art Director review. Create motion graphic assets (banners, transitions, animated ads) that elevate campaign quality and align with brand guidelines without requiring rework. Videography Own the full video production pipeline end-to-end — from pre-production planning and on-location shooting to final post-production — delivering brand-standard footage that requires minimal Art Director intervention. Ensure all video content is optimized across platforms (social, digital, internal) from day one. UI/UX Design Deliver dev-handoff-ready wireframes and interactive prototypes for landing pages and digital interfaces. All designs must be validated with relevant stakeholders before moving to build — with clear user journey documentation and responsive thinking baked in from the start. Creative Execution (Multi-Format) Handle multi-format ad creative variations (1:1, 9:16, 16:9) independently across campaign, social, and collateral needs — maintaining consistent visual quality across all brands with on-time delivery, every time.
qualification: Expert-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, XD) and Final Cut Pro. No ramp-up time required — expected to execute from week one. Proven ability to context-switch between video editing, motion design, UI/UX, and print without quality drop. Portfolio must demonstrate competency across all disciplines, not just one. Internalizes brand guidelines quickly and maintains visual identity independently across all formats and channels — without requiring constant oversight or correction. Manages multiple concurrent projects autonomously. Self-prioritizes, hits deadlines, and flags blockers early. Does not need to be micromanaged on delivery. Thinking Designs with CTR and conversion in mind — understands hooks, visual hierarchy, and ad fatigue. Iterates on creative based on performance data, not just aesthetic preference. Nice to Have: 2D Animation & Motion Branding Familiarity with logo animations, transitions, and explainer animation via After Effects or equivalent. Valuable for brand elevation work and campaign launch assets.

Process Improvement: Provide strategic recommendations to management based on complaint trends to enhance overall service quality and client satisfaction.

Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented in managing campaigns and activations. Nice-to-Have Experience working with premium or service-based brands. Strong visual taste and storytelling sense. Experience leading or coordinating a small creative team. Familiarity with beauty, wellness, or experience-driven brand enironments.

job_description: Menyusun dan melaksanakan Annual Internal Audit Plan berdasarkan hasil penilaian risiko perusahaan. Memimpin pelaksanaan audit operasional, keuangan, kepatuhan, dan audit khusus pada seluruh unit bisnis, termasuk pabrik, gudang, kantor pusat, dan distribusi. Mengevaluasi efektivitas sistem pengendalian internal, manajemen risiko, serta proses bisnis perusahaan. Melaksanakan audit persediaan (inventory), aset perusahaan, serta menginvestigasi selisih stok dan potensi penyimpangan. Mengidentifikasi potensi fraud, pemborosan, maupun kelemahan pengendalian, serta memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan yang efektif. Memantau pelaksanaan tindak lanjut atas temuan audit hingga seluruh rekomendasi dijalankan dengan baik. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan hasil audit yang akurat, objektif, dan memberikan nilai tambah bagi manajemen. Memimpin, membina, dan mengembangkan tim Internal Audit untuk meningkatkan kompetensi dan kinerja. Mendukung penerapan Good Corporate Governance (GCG), manajemen risiko, dan budaya kepatuhan di seluruh perusahaan
qualification: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Manajemen, Teknik Industri, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 8 tahun di bidang Internal Audit, dengan minimal 3 tahun pada posisi Supervisor, Section Head, Assistant Manager, atau Deputy Department Head. Berpengalaman di perusahaan manufaktur dan/atau perusahaan trading/distribusi. Pengalaman di industri FMCG, Food & Beverage, atau Pet Food menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami audit operasional, audit keuangan, audit kepatuhan, pengendalian internal, manajemen risiko, dan investigasi fraud. Memahami proses bisnis manufaktur, pergudangan, pengadaan, supply chain, distribusi, serta pengelolaan persediaan. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan penyusunan laporan yang baik. Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, komunikasi yang efektif, serta mampu bekerja sama dengan seluruh fungsi bisnis. Berintegritas tinggi, objektif, teliti, dan mampu menjaga kerahasiaan informasi perusahaan. Menguasai Microsoft Excel dan terbiasa menggunakan sistem ERP (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, atau sistem sejenis). Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke seluruh lokasi operasional perusahaan. Nilai Tambah Memiliki sertifikasi profesional seperti CIA, QIA, CISA, CRMA, CPA, atau sertifikasi audit lainnya. Berpengalaman memimpin audit lintas fungsi dan mendorong implementasi perbaikan proses bisnis secara berkelanjutan.

job_description: Lead a team of engineers in developing IT infrastructure architecture (servers, networks, storage)—including conceptual, logical, and physical designs—along with documentation, test plans, and risk assessments to ensure a robust architecture aligned with corporate strategy. Lead the analysis, design, troubleshooting, and implementation of network architecture to meet business needs. Manage and optimize storage infrastructure (SAN/NAS), including capacity planning, tiering, and performance monitoring. Mentor engineers to build a strong and qualified engineering team. Evaluate cost analyses and vendor comparisons for large projects to ensure cost and operational efficiency and assess the feasibility of various solution approaches. Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, system architecture diagrams, and disaster recovery procedures. Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, cost optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives to support business growth. Oversee change management, backup, and disaster recovery processes to minimize downtime and maintain data integrity. Implement and maintain system and network security, including patching, configuring, and monitoring routers, switches, firewalls, and servers, and ensure compliance with corporate security policies. Coordinate with other teams (application, support, security) and report infrastructure status regularly to superiors.
qualification: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure (server, network, storage, security). Prior team leadership experience is required, with a minimum background as a team leader or supervisor. Have a certifications in CCNA/CCNP, MCSE or equivalent, Security+, CEH, or OSCP would be preffered. Technical Skills: Server: Proficient in server administration (Windows Server and/or Linux), including installation, configuration, hardening, and troubleshooting. Experienced with virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Proxmox), including provisioning, resource management, and HA/clustering. Solid understanding of Webserver, Mailserver, DNS, DHCP, and other supporting server services. Familiar with server performance and capacity monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana, or equivalent). Network: Strong understanding of routing/switching architecture and configuration (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or equivalent). Experienced in firewall management, VPN, and network segmentation. Storage : Experienced in managing storage infrastructure (SAN/NAS), including provisioning, tiering, and performance tuning. Proficient in backup and recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam) and retention/replication strategies to support business-required RTO/RPO. Solid understanding of capacity planning and long-term cost optimization for storage. Security: Strong understanding of system and network security principles: hardening, patch management, access control, and monitoring (SIEM or equivalent). Preferred: experience or working knowledge of Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) whether conducting, coordinating, or following up on remediation of findings. Preferred: familiarity with Red Team/Blue Team exercise concepts for continuous security improvement.

job_description: At Aleph, we design human-centered digital solutions by combining strategy, technology, and creativity. We work closely with clients, treating their business as our own, to align on goals and drive strategic initiatives through research, data, and insights to solve business challenges. Currently, we are pushing initiatives across the organization to provide strategic advisory on the following topics: User Experience : Strategize App or Web experiences that best fit and build the user mental model, and ensure its desirability (pleasant to use), viability (meet business objectives), and feasibility (can be executed). Customer Experience : Redesign customer experiences and journey maps, leverage customer behavior data and insights to create transformative digital interfaces. Product Development & Management : Transform ideas into market-fit products that meet both user needs and business objectives, while guiding the entire product lifecycle—from concept to optimization. Growth & Experimentation : Use data-driven strategies and experimentation to expand customer base, increase loyalty, and maximize lifetime value. Performance Evaluation & Optimization : Analyze and forecast product KPIs, deliver actionable recommendations to drive growth, improve user engagement, and optimize overall performance. As a Strategist , you will play a pivotal role in pushing new initiatives, with responsibilities including: Collaborating with Designers, Researchers, and Engineers to drive strategic initiatives and guide project direction in partnership with Project Leads. Collaborating with clients to understand their context, challenges, and business goals to sharpen our focus scope. Spearheading the team to conduct in-depth research and data analysis to uncover insights and solutions tailored to client challenges. Experimenting with new approaches and discovering best practices for effective problem-solving. Presenting discovered opportunities and solutions to our clients, engaging audiences from the working team to senior leadership. Your Growth Opportunities As part of this role, you’ll have the chance to: Drive your own initiative, sharpen your leadership skills, and shape the project team direction, with the guidance of senior Strategists for advisory and consultation. Explore opportunities to provide strategic advisory on various topics, including but not limited to: Digital Transformation & Strategy : Redefine the role of digital in client's business and accelerate their transformation efforts. Business Projection & Analysis : Project business outcomes, identify risks, and engage with senior management to discuss strategic pivots and implications. Market Positioning : Identify market opportunities, refine brand positioning to increase visibility and strengthen competitive advantage. Go-to-Market : Craft strategies to launch products and services to the right audience at the right time, from market positioning, messaging, and distribution channel selection. Digital Marketing & Personalization : Optimize digital marketing programs across all channels, utilize analytics and precision targeting to create personalized one-to-one campaigns and journeys. New Ways of Working : Enable organisational changes and help clients transform into digital enterprises that scale effectively. Technology Assessment & Improvements : Assess client’s digital system, technology architecture, SDLC process and methodologies to discover area of improvements for better reliability, security, and scalability
qualification: This role is ideal for you who possess: At least 5 years of full-time experience in digital fields requiring strong problem-solving skills (e.g., product management, product research, business intelligence, data analyst, business analyst, management consulting, or corporate strategy) in leading digital companies or start-ups. A relevant tertiary degree in business, IT/computer science, psychology, engineering, or a related discipline. Ability to work with and lead multi-disciplinary teams, with a proven track record of coordinating projects across multiple work-streams. A mix of strategic and creative skills, with a highly structured approach in thinking and analysis. Expertise in quantitative analysis, with strong business acumen and a proven track record in data analysis and/or product research. Proven proficiency in data modeling and statistical analysis tools are highly regarded. Excellent communication skills in both written and verbal formats, capable of explaining complex concepts in simple terms clearly, concisely, and confidently. Experienced in presenting to key stakeholders, including senior management. History of building relationships and connecting with clients from various levels to align strategy and tactics, and share insights. Intellectual curiosity, resourcefulness, and exceptional attention to detail. A self-driven pursuit of excellence, consistently going the extra mile to elevate the quality of insights and deliverables. High adaptability and agility in tackling problems, with comfort in navigating uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity.

Experience working with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing is an advantage.

job_description: Melakukan kunjungan harian ke Area Hub untuk mengontrol aktivitas operasional guna meminimalisir risiko dan potensi kerugian bagi perusahaan. Melakukan penilaian risiko untuk setiap proyek baru yang terkait dengan Area Hub (pembukaan, penutupan, penggabungan, dll). Melakukan validasi terhadap risiko utama/top dan kontrol berdasarkan matriks risiko (per kategori dan level) yang ditetapkan oleh Tim Operasional di Area Hub. Melakukan pemeriksaan, mitigasi, dan investigasi bersama pihak eksternal (vendor, kepolisian, atau instansi lain bila diperlukan) atas indikasi terjadinya kecurangan internal atau kesalahan penanganan persediaan dan aset perusahaan. Menyediakan rencana mitigasi serta rekomendasi atas potensi kerugian yang disebabkan oleh kurangnya SOP, kesalahan manusia, atau keterbatasan sistem. Memberikan dukungan on-call/standby (misalnya pada kondisi darurat) kepada Tim Operasional maupun Fungsi Lain terkait proyek yang sedang berjalan dan membutuhkan pengamanan serta tindakan pencegahan kerugian. Bertanggung jawab untuk mencegah kerugian dan permasalahan yang terjadi di Hub. Memeriksa kondisi lapangan serta melakukan validasi atas inventory dan aset yang bersifat high value. Melaksanakan kegiatan administrasi dalam bentuk laporan harian, mingguan, dan bulanan. Menyusun laporan hasil investigasi (incident report) lengkap dengan kronologi, bukti, dan rekomendasi.
qualification: Lulusan SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Bersedia bekerja dengan jam kerja yang fleksibel. Bersedia bekerja on-site di berbagai area (misalnya Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, Bekasi). Bersedia bekerja on-call / standby pada akhir pekan (jika diperlukan). Memiliki pengalaman sebagai loss prevention atau risk assessor minimal 1 tahun di industri ritel. Memiliki kemampuan problem-solving dan berpikir analitis yang baik. Memiliki kepekaan yang baik dalam mengidentifikasi indikasi kecurangan dan potensi risiko. Memiliki kemampuan melakukan analisis data serta menggunakan tools/sistem visualisasi (misalnya Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint, Metabase, Google Looker Studio, WMS). Berpengalaman bekerja di lingkungan kerja yang dinamis (fast-paced) dengan rasa kepemilikan (ownership) yang tinggi. Mahir dalam mengelola banyak proyek dan stakeholder secara bersamaan.

location: 6754 Ayala Avenue, Legazpi Village, Makati, Metro Manila, Philippines
job_description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the Role As a Pro Success Manager, you'll be a hands-on people leader focused on helping Pros get real, measurable value from Thumbtack. You'll lead a team of Success Specialists who drive retention, product satisfaction, and growth across their Pro portfolios. You'll ensure the team delivers consistent results through coaching, data-driven execution, and operational discipline. This role is ideal for a leader who thrives in the details — motivating people, refining playbooks, and translating insights into immediate action to reduce churn and improve satisfaction. What you’ll do Lead and coach a team: Manage 8-10 Success Specialists responsible for retention, satisfaction, churn prevention, and growth. Churn prevention: Use health signals and reporting to identify risk; coach your team on recovery tactics and ensure follow-through. Drive product satisfaction: Ensure pros understand and adopt high-impact features; provide feedback loops to Product for improvement. Renewals and expansion: Support your team in executing renewals and identifying upsell opportunities with structure and consistency. Data-driven leadership: Monitor metrics (NRR, GRR, churn rate, CSAT, adoption, TTV); use insights in 1:ls and team reviews to drive performance. Process excellence: Implement playbooks for onboarding, adoption, renewal, and QBRs; identify process gaps and propose fixes. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales to communicate Pro feedback and influence improvements. Talent development: Conduct regular coaching sessions, monitor progress toward goals, and celebrate wins that model Thumbtack's values. Pro advocacy: Encourage Pros to share success stories and promote Thumbtack through testimonials and case studies.
qualification: In order to be successful, you must bring 8+ years of experience leading Customer Success, Account Management, or similar post-sales organizations in a B2B, SaaS, or marketplace environment. 3+ years of experience leading Sales teams with quotas and KPIs and managing or mentoring customer-facing teams. Experience with account relationships and growth management of large strategic clients and enterprises. Strong track record managing performance, workflows, and outcomes across multiple time zones. Ability to adapt coaching and communication styles across cultural norms while maintaining clarity and accountability. Proven success driving retention, satisfaction, and revenue results across measurable KPIs (NRR, GRR, churn rate, CSAT/NPS). Strong analytical skills and comfort using CRM and CS tools (Salesforce, ChurnZero/Gainsight, Looker/Tableau, Google Sheets). Excellent communication and influencing skills across teams and customer segments. Demonstrated Al literacy — able to leverage tools and insights to optimize customer engagement and internal efficiency. Experience developing talent remotely, including feedback, upskilling, and building trust with offshore teams. Strong operational mindset with comfort using data to diagnose issues, drive decisions, and measure improvement. History of navigating change management across global teams, ensuring alignment and adoption of new processes. Able to be flexible and agile in responding to evolving business priorities and dealing with ambiguity

job_description: Monitor software systems to ensure their reliability, performance, and availability for 24x7 by shifting. Experience with automation or scripting is a plus. Willing to work in a 24x7 operational environment (shift-based if required).

job_description: Mengawasi dan memastikan seluruh proses pencatatan transaksi keuangan berjalan akurat dan tepat waktu. Menjadi PIC dalam proses audit internal maupun eksternal, termasuk penyediaan data dan penjelasan atas temuan audit. Melakukan monitoring dan kontrol atas transaksi, dokumen pendukung, serta kepatuhan terhadap SOP akuntansi. Memberikan arahan, mentoring, dan pengembangan bagi tim akuntansi. Berkoordinasi dengan tim finance dan departemen lain untuk memastikan kelengkapan data dan kelancaran proses keuangan. Menjalankan tugas tambahan lain yang diberikan oleh manajemen terkait fungsi akuntansi.

Memonitor pembayaran selama periode waktu tertentu sesuai dengan parameter yang ditetapkan oleh perusahaan dan bekerjasama Kelancaran pembayaran angsuran dengan fungsi AR management untuk memastikan agar pelanggan yang telah jatuh tempo memenuhi kewajibannya.

job_description: Clear is looking for a Recruiter to work with our client, an Australia-based company offering occupational health services, in a remote work setup. Your daily tasks may include: Write, post, and manage job advertisements for nursing, allied health, and clinic administration roles across relevant job advertising platforms, ensuring listings are accurate, tailored to each role type, and actively driving quality applications Monitor and action incoming applications daily, acknowledging all candidates promptly and moving qualified applicants through to the next stage in accordance with the client's procedures Conduct proactive database searches to identify suitable candidates from existing records and match them against current role requirements for both recurring and newly opened positions Float strong and available candidates to the consulting team and hiring managers ahead of demand, particularly for high-turnover clinic roles where pipeline continuity is critical Stay current on market trends, competitor activity, candidate pay rates, and supply conditions in the occupational health and allied health talent markets, and communicate relevant updates to the team Conduct initial telephone screenings of applicants to assess clinical qualifications, availability, and suitability for specific clinic roles Provide the shortlisted candidate resumes and a brief summary from the telephone screening to HR and the hiring manager to determine which candidate to schedule an interview with Schedule and facilitate virtual interviews alongside HR and hiring manager, taking notes and ensuring the experience is professional, welcoming, and reflective of the client’s values as an employer Prepare a concise candidate summary following each interview, capturing key details like availability and role fit, to be sent to HR and the hiring manager after the interview Conduct 2 thorough reference checks to verify candidates' professional conduct, clinical competence, and work history, and document all findings. Raise any red flags with HR and advise once completed. Liaise with HR and hiring manager to confirm what clinic location the successful candidate will undertake their 2 weeks of training at. Coordinate the collection and verification of pre-employment requirements valid to the specific role, including AHPRA registrations, ESSA accreditation, working with children checks, first aid, and relevant degree qualifications. Advise the successful candidate of the offer of employment via telephone. job_title: Virtual Teammate — Help Grow a Marketplace for University Students — Fully Remote, Training Provided
location: San Francisco, California, United States
job_description: Hi! I'm the founder of SUpost, the trusted online marketplace for the university communities. We're the go-to spot where university students buy and sell stuff, find roommates, score concert tickets, hire tutors, and connect with each other. Think of us as the friendly, university-only version of Facebook Marketplace, OLX or Craigslist — except people actually trust us. We serve 131,000 users every year, we're profitable, and we've been around for over a decade. Now we're ready for our next adventure: expanding to more elite universities around the world — and we want you on the team to help make it happen. This isn't a role where you'll be stuck in spreadsheets all day (though we do love a good spreadsheet). You'll be working directly with me, the founder, on the actual fun stuff that makes a startup grow. What You'll Actually Do (the fun part) Business development — help us figure out which universities to launch in next and how to win them over Customer discovery — talk to real students, learn what they love (and hate), and bring those insights back to shape the product Product design input — share ideas on how the website should look, feel, and work for students Campus outreach — help us reach students at new universities and grow our community Founder collaboration — brainstorm, strategize, and execute together on growth experiments You'll learn what it actually takes to scale an online marketplace — not in theory, but by doing it. Tools We Use Google Sheets & Docs Dropbox Paper Telegram Zoom / Google Meet for video calls Why This Role Is Awesome Direct mentorship from a Stanford grad (PhD, MS, BS — yes, all three!) Real ownership — you'll work on the things that move the needle, not coffee runs or busy work Fully remote — work from home, in your favorite hoodie Flexible hours — we care about results, not clock-watching Clear path to grow into Senior Operations, Team Lead, or Business/Strategy roles International team — you'll be working with people who genuinely care about building something meaningful Learn how startups really work — the messy, exciting, "we're figuring it out together" version Who This Role Is Perfect For A curious, motivated early-career professional Someone who wants to build, not just check boxes A future leader who wants to grow alongside a startup Anyone interested in marketplaces, tech, business development, or product Ateneo and top-university graduates who want global exposure and real responsibility Location Philippines (or wherever you call home) Fully remote (work from home) Open to future relocation opportunities Salary Discussed during interview Base pay + performance-based incentives (because when we grow, you grow) Perks & Benefits Flexitime Work from home Mentorship & career development Real startup experience (not the buzzword kind)
qualification: We're looking for someone smart, curious, and excited to learn. You don't need prior business development or sales experience — we'll teach you everything you need to know. Required: Strong English communication skills — especially writing clear, friendly, professional messages and emails Organized, reliable, and proactive (the kind of person who follows through) Comfortable working independently in a remote setup Genuinely interested in learning about business, marketplaces, and how startups grow Nice to Have (but not required): Curiosity about startups, online marketplaces, or internet businesses Interest in product design, customer research, or business development Comfort with Google Docs / Sheets or similar tools A favorite emoji you're not afraid to use
